en.name: LATAM Business Mission — Q2 2026
en.description: A focused trade visit across Sao Paulo, Mexico City, and Bogota for Chinese teams exploring distribution, partnerships, and on-the-ground reality.
en.detailSubtitle: An operator-led mission for Chinese teams that need a direct read on LATAM partners, distributors, and customer expectations.
en.metaTitle: LATAM Business Mission Q2 2026 | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Eight-day LATAM trade visit across Sao Paulo, Mexico City, and Bogota for Chinese teams exploring partnerships and distribution.
en.bodyHtml:
The Q2 LATAM mission gives Chinese operators a direct look at how the region actually buys, distributes, and partners. Each stop is structured around real conversations with operators who already work the corridor.

Cities

  • Sao Paulo — distribution, partnerships, and B2B reality.
  • Mexico City — channels, regulatory context, and corporate buyers.
  • Bogota — Andean expansion patterns and regional logistics.

br.name: Missao de Negocios LATAM — 2T 2026
br.description: Visita focada por Sao Paulo, Cidade do Mexico e Bogota para times chineses explorando distribuicao, parcerias e realidade local.
br.detailSubtitle: Missao conduzida por operadores para times chineses que precisam de leitura direta sobre parceiros, distribuidores e expectativas LATAM.
br.metaDescription: Visita de oito dias por Sao Paulo, Cidade do Mexico e Bogota para times chineses explorando parcerias e distribuicao na LATAM.
br.bodyHtml:
A missao LATAM do 2T da aos operadores chineses uma visao direta de como a regiao realmente compra, distribui e faz parcerias. Cada parada e estruturada em conversas reais com operadores que ja atuam no corredor.

Cidades

  • Sao Paulo — distribuicao, parcerias e realidade B2B.
  • Cidade do Mexico — canais, contexto regulatorio e compradores corporativos.
  • Bogota — padroes de expansao andina e logistica regional.

cn.name: 2026 年第二季度拉美商务考察
cn.description: 针对中国团队的精选行程，走访圣保罗、墨西哥城和波哥大，了解分销、合作与本地现实。
cn.detailSubtitle: 由运营者主导的考察，面向需要直接了解拉美合作伙伴、分销商与客户期望的中国团队。
cn.metaTitle: 2026年Q2拉美商务考察 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 为期八天的拉美行程，走访圣保罗、墨西哥城和波哥大，帮助中国团队了解合作与分销机会。
cn.bodyHtml:
第二季度拉美考察让中国运营者直接了解该地区真实的采购、分销与合作方式。每一站都围绕已经在跨境通道工作的运营者展开真实对话。

走访城市

  • 圣保罗——分销、合作与 B2B 现实。
  • 墨西哥城——渠道、监管语境与企业买方。
  • 波哥大——安第斯区域扩张模式与物流。
